title: Mystical Plasma Orb
description: A glowing glass plasma orb sits on a metallic stand atop a wooden table. Inside the transparent sphere, a pink central orb emits bright yellow energy tendrils connecting to floating circular and flower-shaped elements, with a green dog-like creature standing in a pool of flowing blue liquid.
prompt: Surreal nighttime scene featuring a large transparent glass plasma orb on a metallic stand placed on a wooden table. Inside the orb, a bright pink glowing core emits vibrant yellow energy beams connecting to floating blue flower shapes and circular patterns. A lime green dog-like creature with pink eyes stands inside the orb in a pool of flowing blue liquid. Background shows a dark purple landscape with cliffs, pine trees and a glowing horizontal energy band with orange light streaks. Vibrant colors, painterly style.
